title: Every declared journey specified and rendering across its six states
iWant: every step to look designed no matter what state I hit it in
soThat: edge states feel as finished as the happy path

acceptanceCriteria.description: The project maintains a journey inventory; every declared journey maps each step to a route and to specifications for arrival, loading, empty, error, success, and re-entry states.
acceptanceCriteria.when: each journey is walked against the specifications
acceptanceCriteria.then: all six states are specified for every step

acceptanceCriteria.description: Arrival states render meaningful content or structure immediately; no journey step opens on an unexplained blank region.
acceptanceCriteria.then: designed arrival content is visible without user action

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each journey's error state offers a way forward: retry, an alternative path, or clear guidance, per application-spa-REQ-017.
acceptanceCriteria.given: each journey step forced into error
acceptanceCriteria.then: a forward path is present and operable

acceptanceCriteria.description: Re-entry into a journey restores or gracefully resets context per the journey specification; expired-session re-entry routes through the application-spa-US-1116 flow back to the same step.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a user mid-journey who leaves and returns
acceptanceCriteria.when: re-entry occurs, including with an expired session
acceptanceCriteria.then: the declared restore-or-reset behaviour happens and no entered data is silently lost

acceptanceCriteria.description: Journey checkpoint telemetry per application-spa-REQ-016 fires at each declared checkpoint across all six states, so abandoned journeys are observable.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a journey walked through each state
acceptanceCriteria.then: the declared checkpoint events fire with correct names
